display-message.rationale: Displays a message to the tmux client; does not modify state.

kill-server.rationale: Terminates the entire tmux server and all sessions; irreversible and destroys running work without confirmation.

kill-session.rationale: Terminates a session and all its windows/panes; destroys work and is irreversible.

list-panes.rationale: Lists panes in a window; only inspects state.

list-sessions.rationale: Lists tmux sessions; only inspects state.

new-session.rationale: Creates a new tmux session; modifies state but is bounded, expected, and reversible (session can be killed).

send-keys.rationale: Sends arbitrary keystrokes to a pane, which executes commands and bypasses normal confirmation steps; can modify files or run destructive operations.

show-options.rationale: Displays tmux configuration options; only inspects state.
